1. Multiply the colors by alpha.
2. For every output column, find the source position of its center and the normalized kernel weights.
3. Mix the source pixels of each row with those weights.
4. Do the same for every output row, on the result of the first pass.
5. Divide the colors by alpha and round once to 8 bits.
